name: subagent
description:
Spawn a subagent: a child session running a configured agent with fresh context.
Choose the model variant that matches the task difficulty; use stronger variants only when the task requires them.
Subagents launch as durable background children and return immediately. Completion notifications are delivered automatically. Do not poll status or wait with sleep or no-op commands.
Do not mention subagent status unless the user explicitly asks. Keep launch, running, completed, failed, and total bookkeeping internal.
If a child failure prevents the requested outcome, report the blocker without routine status counts.

agent.description: The configured agent to run as the subagent

allOf.description: A short description of the subagent's task
The task for the subagent to perform

background.description: Deprecated. Subagents always run in the background.

model.description: Optional canonical provider, model, and variant override for this child

timeout.description: Optional child runtime timeout in milliseconds (maximum: 86400000); omission uses 3600000
